administrations.notes: Immediate predecessor administration to Mara Velic. Marenkov won the 2013 regular presidential election (second Saturday in October) and assumed office 2014-01-20. Velic won the 2018 election; Marenkov remained president until Velic assumed office on 2019-01-20. Resolves the 2017 Constitutional Court appointment.
First elected presidential term. Regular election 2018-10-13; assumed office 2019-01-20.
Second elected presidential term. Regular election 2023-10-14; assumed office 2024-01-20. Term-limited; not eligible in 2028. Next regular election 2028-10-14; successor assumes office 2029-01-20.

historical_persons.name: Ivo Marenkov
historical_persons.notes: President of Terena 2014-01-20 to 2019-01-20; elected 2013; National Union.
